correct.evidence: Hand-checked address (2026-09-25 + 10 = 2026-10-05), absence (2027-09-30 + 5 months = 2028-02-29) and signature (2026-03-31 + 6 months = 2026-09-30) dates are right. Blocking finding 2: with job w1 ended 2026-08-01 and confirmed 2026-07-15 the count is 30 as of 2026-07-15 but limit_day is 2026-09-30, a past day counted beyond the last confirmed day (N3).

sourced.evidence: Every new rule (address.report_change_within_days, passport.*, visa.validity_is_for_admission) is verbatim with a saved snapshot; sources verify, recheck --check and plain pass. Two labels copy the five and six months by hand (finding 7); two unmarked readings in notes.

never_assumes.evidence: Blocking findings 1, 3 and 4: a job with no confirmed_on (declared ask) is counted through today with nothing asked; two addresses with no previous are both read as the first, dropping a move whose report closes 2026-10-05; a trip with returned_on before left_on still shows trip.absence_limit dated (point 32a).

inside_the_boundary.evidence: No modal, status or outcome words in watch, check-ins or windows; close and due are settings and say so. The check-in question shows as 'Some facts entered do not fit together.' (finding 6) and two trip labels begin 'Return ...' as instructions (finding 7).

secure.evidence: Tried a dangling link (ad9), a self link, 2026-09-31 and 2026-02-30, not_sure, future confirmed and signature days, negative and fractional hours: no crash or stall; each becomes a question or a value, and every output validates against the schema.

tested.evidence: Suite exit 0; mutants M2 to M6 caught. Mutant M1 (count runs through today instead of the last confirmed day) survives every W2-P2 test, and none of blocking findings 1 to 4 has a test (finding 5).

findings.title: A job never confirmed is counted through today, and nothing is asked
findings.input: on_opt(job()): OPT card 2026-06-01 to 2027-05-31, w1 from 2026-07-01 at 40 hours, no confirmed_on; today 2026-10-02
findings.what_happens: unemployment.opt_card.a1 = 30 with no as_of and no waits_on; checkin confirmed_on/due null; no question. work.confirmed_on is when_absent ask by default, but _confirmed reads its absence as confirmed through today; the count differs by fill, so it must be withheld and asked, or the pack must declare none with screen words.

findings.title: The limit day counts past the last confirmed day
findings.what_happens: Count 30 with as_of 2026-07-15, but limit_day 2026-09-30 (past, no waits_on), the 90th day of days counted through today. The two outputs contradict each other; a check-in is also asked on the ended job.

findings.title: Two addresses with no link are both read as the first, and the move is dropped
findings.input: lists stated; ad1 since 2025-08-15 and ad2 since 2026-09-25, neither with previous
findings.what_happens: No address.report window, no question, no conflict. previous is declared none ('the first address in the US'), which two records cannot both be; a move by 2026-09-25 with a report closing 2026-10-05 is read as none.

findings.title: A trip whose span does not fit still shows dated windows
findings.input: trip t1 left_on 2026-09-20, returned_on 2026-09-01, signature_on 2026-06-01, on OPT
findings.what_happens: Stage trip.t1 is unknown and span_order.t1 is asked, but trip.absence_limit.t1 shows closes 2027-02-20 with no waits_on, resting on a left_on the record contradicts.

findings.title: The core of N3 is untested
findings.input: mutant M1: through = self.today in place of min([self.today, *tr.as_of])
findings.what_happens: All W2-P2 unit and holdout tests pass: no case has a day without work after the confirmed day. None of the blocking findings has a test.

findings.title: The check-in question is worded as a conflict
findings.what_happens: questionTitle gives 'Job 1: Some facts entered do not fit together.'; nothing conflicts, and the check-in words of G8 are missing.

findings.title: Trip window labels copy the numbers by hand and read as instructions
findings.input: any trip: 'Return from a temporary absence of five months or less', 'Return with a Form I-20 endorsed for reentry within the last six months' (line 2163)
findings.what_happens: The five and six copy travel.absence_months and travel.opt_signature_months; other window labels say 'the rule's days'. 'Return ...' is an instruction where fix0 asked for labels that state the date only.

findings.title: Watch reads passport and visa lists never asked whole
findings.input: case with complete.passport and complete.visa removed
findings.what_happens: No passport or visa row and no complete question; watch[] is soonest first and G10 will read its first row, a first over a list not stated whole (point 14). Neither kind has a complete_label.

findings.title: Date order conflicts in the new records are not asked
findings.input: ad2 since 2026-09-25 moved from ad1 since 2026-09-28; ad2.previous = ad2; visa issued 2026-01-01 expiring 2025-01-01; reported_on 2026-09-01 before a move on 2026-09-25
findings.what_happens: Each is accepted with no question: the window or watch row is shown as for a record that fits.

findings.title: A trip leaving before the card and returning on it has no signature window
findings.input: trip left 2026-05-20, returned 2026-06-10, signature 2026-05-01, OPT card from 2026-06-01
findings.what_happens: No trip_opt stage, while the check trip.signature_for_opt_return (selected by the return) still judges the trip; the stage and the check select different trips.

findings.title: Smaller points
findings.input: replaced passport expired 2026-01-01; pending OPT application; trip on OPT; hours 200
findings.what_happens: A passed date stays close and sorts first; a pending card end gives a null watch row with nothing asked (declared not_yet); (f)(17) counted from since and (f)(4) applied on OPT are unmarked readings; hours above 168 are counted.
